description: The ask card's send button or its close button (ADR 0066): the card's `id` and either `answers`, keyed by the `label` of each field (a field left blank is dropped), or `dismiss`. The brain answers `{status, turn_id}`: `accepted` with the turn the answers start, `dismissed` with `turn_id` null and nothing run. Another body is refused with the status in `refusal`: 422 for a body that is not this shape, 400 when nothing was filled in and it was not dismissed, 409 once the card is no longer the one waiting.

valid.name: one field filled in and one left blank
the close button with answers beside it (they are dropped)

invalid.name: answers that are not an object
neither answers nor the close button
the id of a card that is gone
